scripts.dev:full: npm run build:web && npm --prefix services/gateway exec wrangler -- dev
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:gateway
scripts.build:api-gateway: wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir workers/api-gateway/.generated --fallback-service ASSETS
scripts.deploy:api-gateway: npm run build:api-gateway && wrangler deploy --config workers/api-gateway/wrangler.jsonc --env=""
scripts.deploy:api-gateway:staging: npm run build:api-gateway && wrangler deploy --config workers/api-gateway/wrangler.jsonc --env=staging
scripts.deploy:noxhere: npm run build:web && npm --prefix services/gateway run deploy:production
scripts.deploy:noxhere:staging: npm run build:web && npm --prefix services/gateway run deploy:staging
scripts.deploy:noxspot:staging: npm --prefix services/spot run types -- --env staging && wrangler deploy --config services/spot/wrangler.jsonc --env=staging
scripts.sdk:generate: npm run openapi:standardize && node scripts/generate-sdk-contract.mjs && node scripts/generate-sdk-events.mjs && npm --prefix packages/sdk run generate && python3 packages/python-sdk/scripts/generate_operations.py && python3 packages/swift-sdk/scripts/generate_operations.py
scripts.sdk:check: npm run openapi:check && node scripts/generate-sdk-contract.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-sdk-events.mjs --check && npm --prefix packages/sdk run generate:check && python3 packages/python-sdk/scripts/generate_operations.py --check && python3 packages/swift-sdk/scripts/generate_operations.py --check
scripts.docs:check: npm run openapi:check && npm run docs:cli-check && npm run docs:stale-check && vitest run functions/api/__tests__/developer-docs.test.js functions/api/__tests__/direct-api-examples.test.js functions/api/__tests__/openapi-capabilities.test.ts functions/api/__tests__/openapi-routes.test.js functions/api/__tests__/client-api-parity.test.js
scripts.test:sdk: npm run sdk:check && npm --prefix packages/sdk test && PYTHONPATH=packages/python-sdk/src python3 -m unittest discover -s packages/python-sdk/tests -v
scripts.build:sdk: npm run sdk:check && npm --prefix packages/sdk run build && swift build --package-path packages/swift-sdk
